prompt: Yellow calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade Day
irony: Yellow calls the parade like a fast race and it falls apart, so it only turns big when she calls it slow and all march together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Yellow waves striped flags on her porch while Green and Navy line up on the sunny street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green hugs his marching-steps book and wants the front flag but freezes at the white line.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Yellow shouts And they're off and Black dares everyone to race downtown, splitting the line.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street chants the parade hook and waves flags as the drums start.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The kids sprint for the corner, flags tangle, and Green reads while the drums stall behind him.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Black's toy cart zooms past the curb, hats fly, and the whole march piles up laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The street chants the hook again, slower, picking up hats and flags together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Yellow puts her horn down and sees her fast calls rush the kids past their big day.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Yellow decides to call slow steps so Green leads the march and everyone stays together.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crowd sings the hook while Yellow turns the last line and Black hands Green the front flag.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The street sings the hook again on the sunny street, marching slow and together at last.
